before_excise_comparison.reading: The deck-basis rows (cube before excise at 4.91, can after excise at 4.127) are the scenario in which only the can bears excise. Against the run with both products before excise on the can's invoice chain (cube 5.25, can 5.33) the break-even share is 30.9 against 30.3 percent. At a share of 25 percent the deck-basis NPV is THB 0.02 million lower; at 50 and 100 percent it is THB 0.14 and 0.46 million less negative. The deck-basis figures are therefore a close read at 25 percent and flatter the NPV at 50 and 100 percent.

after_excise.basis_note: Lead. Cube and can both after excise. Consistent.

before_excise.basis_note: Deck basis (ex-factory 9.00). At a cannibalised share of 0 the can does not enter. At a share above 0 it nets a before-excise cube against the can's after-excise contribution, which is the scenario in which the cube is outside the excise and the can is inside it (the cube's excise classification is not determined). Those rows are flagged cube_outside_excise_can_inside_row and must carry that label wherever they are quoted.

before_excise_chain.basis_note: Team record only. Cube and can both on the can's invoice before excise. Used to compare with the deck-basis rows.

contribution_bases.note: The after-excise basis is the lead because the can contribution is after excise and the cannibalisation netting must compare like with like. The before-excise basis (4.91) is the basis of the current deck and submission figures; at a cannibalised share above 0 it is the scenario in which the cube is outside the excise and the can is inside it. Excise classification and base of the cube are not verified.

contribution_margin_of_safety.reading: With no cannibalisation the NPV is zero at a contribution of about THB 3.64 a cube, THB 0.31 (7.8 percent) below the lead contribution of THB 3.94. The unpriced binder and flavour, the assumed pouch, print and processing costs and the excise base each move the contribution by that much or more, so the sign of the headline NPV is not robust.

contribution_reconciliation_3_65_vs_3_94.reading: Both take 14 percent excise off an invoice. Line 103 of submission 05 takes it off the assumed ex-factory price of THB 9.00 (60 percent of the shelf price); the chain takes it off the invoice of THB 9.34 that VAT 7 percent, the retailer margin of 21.6 percent and the distributor margin of 15 percent leave from the same THB 15 shelf price. The THB 0.29 gap is the difference between the two invoices (THB 0.34) after excise.

denominators.note: Both denominators are single-company press figures, not consolidated group profit, which was not found. Boon Rawd Brewery's 2022 net profit was about 1.9 times Singha Corporation's 2025 net profit, so a wider profit base would make every share smaller. Singha Corporation's profit includes dividends from group companies, so the two companies' profits cannot be added.

stop_rule_contribution_floor_thb_per_cub.note: Deck slides 11 and 13 and submission 06 set a floor of 3.51 (4.91 less 1.40 for a 2.70 THB pouch). The same 1.40 cost rise on the after-excise basis leaves the floor at the value shown

method.before_excise_scenario: The before_excise basis nets a before-excise cube (4.91) against the can's after-excise contribution (4.127) when the cannibalised share is above zero. That is the scenario in which the cube is outside the excise and the can is inside it; rows are flagged cube_outside_excise_can_inside_row and carry that label. before_excise_chain is the run with both products before excise, compared in before_excise_comparison.
method.bias: The can contribution is before aluminium (loss overstated, which lowers the cannibalisation break points); the cube contribution excludes binder and flavour (value overstated, which raises them). The two are not sized, so the net direction is not known
method.break_points: NPV is linear in the cannibalised share, in volume, in fixed cost and in the contribution per cube, so the zero points are closed form
method.cash_flow_year_t: after-tax: (EBITDA_t minus depreciation_t) times (1 minus 20 percent) plus depreciation_t, t = 1..5; year 0 = minus setup outlay
method.cost_of_capital: Bank of Thailand policy rate 1.00 percent (S) plus a premium of 7, 9 and 11 points (ASSUMPTION): 8, 10 and 12 percent; the 10 percent base was kept from the earlier model
method.depreciation: setup outlay (equal to one year's fixed cost) straight line over five years
method.dividends: payout times positive incremental net profit; received by Boon Rawd at the stated ownership (100 percent assumed); passed to holders at the stated share
method.ebitda_t: cubes_t times contribution, minus cannibalised share times can contribution times cubes_t, minus fixed cost
method.npv_uplift: after-tax NPV at the base rate
method.pe_uplift: peer trailing P/E times steady-state (year 2) incremental net profit; no terminal value in the project, so this overstates a five-year stream
method.roic: steady-state (year 2) incremental net profit divided by the invested capital (setup outlay); upper bound, no working capital; compared with the cost of capital
method.scale: steady-state cubes a year at which incremental net profit equals the stated share of the reference net profit
method.share_of_np: incremental net profit divided by Singha Corporation net profit 2025 (3,085 million), held flat
method.tax: 20 percent of the net incremental profit before tax, as if the cube and the can were booked in one taxpayer; a loss year gives a same-year credit in the base. Carry-forward and no-relief variants are in tax_loss_treatment

pilot_review_level.basis: after_excise (lead); 200,000 cubes a year; THB 500,000 fixed cost; 10 percent; after tax
pilot_review_level.mapping: displaced cans per cube = stated switch share x cans lost per cube bought by a switcher (displacement factor). The model sets the factor to 1 (ASSUMPTION), so the model's cannibalised share equals the stated share.
pilot_review_level.proposed_review_level_basis: The break-even of about 7.5 percent rounded down to a whole percent. DERIVED on ASSUMPTION inputs. It moves with volume, contribution and the displacement factor, so it is re-read from the model with the pilot's own measured values.
pilot_review_level.reading: The old trigger of 50 percent stated switchers lies far above the break-even: at 200,000 cubes a year the NPV is already minus THB 0.94 million there, and the volume at which it returns to zero is about 386,542 cubes a year. At 50,000 cubes a year the NPV is negative even with no cannibalisation, so the break-even share is below zero.
